entry.title: Bran Castle

terrainReference.basis: Retained Terrarium grid center relative to decoded anchor working datum; no architectural survey claim.

entry.note: Fresh exact-Q390275 relation 3300200 v30 and seven outer, court and roof/tower ways match retained coordinates within 0.672 mm. Native +X southeast at 129.515 degrees, +Z southwest at 219.515 degrees. Round western tower, northeast keep/belfry, eastern tower and southwest stair/entrance sign the frame. Retained Terrarium public numeric terrain and a 4225-value 4 m native grid establish contact against one viewer terrain product. Y0 is the decoded 764.9841 m anchor working datum; no regional survey or ellipsoid conversion is asserted. Reconstructed courtyard floor 3.849 m above that datum uses highest mapped outer-boundary sample plus 0.25 m. Architecture receives one rigid -0.151 m translation from the original court basis; footprints and vertical proportions remain intact. Occupied perimeter feet extend 4 m below sampled terrain, court paving stays a thin architectural slab, and host terrain supplies the geological knoll. Whole-precinct replacement/cutout remains disabled. Coarse terrain cannot establish precise cliff or architectural elevations; local Romanian public terrain service was unreachable. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.
